are optional (the date defaults to now in the service). A receipt may be
attached as proof when one is available, but marking an invoice paid never
requires it. Authorization is enforced by the route middleware
(auth:sanctum + role.admin).

pending workspace owner chooses right after registering. Only a workspace
owner who already has a workspace may submit it.

segmentable by subscription status. Behind auth:sanctum + role.owner; the

subject.description: Subject is only meaningful for email; required when email is chosen.

amount is added to the running total; ownership is verified in the controller.

SeatingMode.description: Whether members get an assigned desk or pick any free one.
SeatingMode.title: SeatingMode

Specialization.description: Restricted specialization list that replaces the free-text `specialty` for donor reporting. The legacy free-text column stays untouched.
Specialization.title: Specialization

StoreAdminRequest.description:
Validates creating a new admin account. Authorization is enforced by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + can.manage_admins).
StoreAdminRequest.title: StoreAdminRequest

plan_type.description: Bookings are monthly or daily; "custom" is reserved for admin billing.

StoreChatAttachmentRequest.description:
Validates a chat attachment upload. The route is already behind
`auth:sanctum`, so any authenticated user may attach a file to their chats.
StoreChatAttachmentRequest.title: StoreChatAttachmentRequest

StoreContactRequest.description: Public "Contact us" submission. Unauthenticated — anyone may send a message.
StoreContactRequest.title: StoreContactRequest

StoreDeviceTokenRequest.description: Validates registration of an FCM device token for the authenticated user.
StoreDeviceTokenRequest.title: StoreDeviceTokenRequest

StoreExpenseRequest.description:
Validates a new workspace expense submitted by the owner. Ownership is
enforced in the controller/service (the expense is attached to the owner's
own workspace), so no workspace_id is accepted from the client.
StoreExpenseRequest.title: StoreExpenseRequest

StoreHourPackageRequest.description:
Create or update a catalog package. Authorization is enforced by the route
middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin + can.permission:manage_billing).
StoreHourPackageRequest.title: StoreHourPackageRequest

StoreInvoiceDraftRequest.description:
A v2 invoice draft with its lines. A line tied to an unbilled charge takes
its description, quantity and price from that charge, so those are optional then.
StoreInvoiceDraftRequest.title: StoreInvoiceDraftRequest

StoreResourceRequest.description:
Validates a new workspace resource submitted by the owner. The resource is
attached to the owner's own workspace server-side; no workspace_id is taken.
StoreResourceRequest.title: StoreResourceRequest

StoreRouterRequest.description: Authorization is the controller's workspace-ownership check (behind role.owner).
StoreRouterRequest.title: StoreRouterRequest

StoreUnbilledChargeRequest.description:
Manual unbilled charge. `source` and `amount` are never read from the client:
the source is always manual and the amount is computed by the service.
StoreUnbilledChargeRequest.title: StoreUnbilledChargeRequest

seat_types.description: Optional per-seat-type pricing submitted alongside the workspace.

SubmitReceiptRequest.description:
A member uploads proof of payment for an invoice. Ownership of the invoice is
verified in the controller against the authenticated member.

paid_at.description:
Optional payment date when an owner records the payment; the member
submit flow omits it (the service defaults to now()).

SubmitReceiptRequest.title: SubmitReceiptRequest

logo.description: Dedicated workspace logo, falling back to the owner avatar.

SyncRequest.description:
Validates a router sync batch. Authorization is the `router` middleware's
job (key + workspace code); the limits here keep a batch small enough for
a single transaction. Routers post `text/plain` lines, parsed into the same
array shape the JSON form uses before the rules run.

nonce.description: Echoed into the reply header, so it must not be able to carry a line break.

data.description: An empty chunk is valid: it tells the server nobody is online.

SyncRequest.title: SyncRequest

TestMessagingRequest.description:
Validates the messaging test payload `{ channel: "email"|"sms", to }`.
For email, `to` must be a valid address; for SMS it is a free-form recipient
number. Authorization is handled by route middleware (auth:sanctum +
role.admin).
TestMessagingRequest.title: TestMessagingRequest

TwoFactorChallengeRequest.description: Either an authenticator code or a recovery code (challenge, step-up, disable).
TwoFactorChallengeRequest.title: TwoFactorChallengeRequest

UnbilledChargeSource.description: Where an unbilled charge came from.
UnbilledChargeSource.title: UnbilledChargeSource

UnbilledChargeStatus.description: Lifecycle of an unbilled charge: open until invoiced or voided.
UnbilledChargeStatus.title: UnbilledChargeStatus

UpdateAdminRequest.description:
Validates updating an existing admin account: status, role, permissions, and
an optional password reset. Every field is optional so callers can patch a
single attribute. Self-lockout protection is enforced in the service.
UpdateAdminRequest.title: UpdateAdminRequest

UpdateBrandingRequest.description:
Validates a site-branding payload: the site name, the SEO meta (title +
description) and the three brand image PATHS (favicon, light/dark logos).

Every field is optional — the app falls back to its built-in branding for
anything the admin leaves unset. Image fields carry the canonical media-disk
path returned by the branding image-upload endpoint (a string), not the file
itself. Authorization is handled by the route middleware (auth:sanctum +
role.admin).
UpdateBrandingRequest.title: UpdateBrandingRequest

UpdateExpenseRequest.description:
Validates an edit to an existing workspace expense. Every field is optional
(`sometimes`) so the owner may patch a subset.
UpdateExpenseRequest.title: UpdateExpenseRequest

UpdateInvoiceDraftRequest.description: Replaces a draft's lines and header; the customer cannot change.
UpdateInvoiceDraftRequest.title: UpdateInvoiceDraftRequest

UpdateLandingRequest.description:
Validates the bilingual landing-page CMS payload. Every field is optional
(partial overrides) so any subset of the schema is accepted; the frontend
supplies i18n defaults for anything omitted. Authorization is handled by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).

sections_order.description: --- Section order (admin-chosen order of the reorderable sections) ---

image.description:
Section image: stored media PATH (uploaded via POST .../images).
The resolved display URL (`imageUrl`) is added by the service on
read and accepted here so a round-tripped payload still validates.

UpdateLandingRequest.title: UpdateLandingRequest

UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest.description:
Validates the platform messaging payload `{ smtp?: {...}, sms?: {...} }`.
Every field is optional so partial updates work; secrets may be omitted or
sent blank to preserve the stored value. Authorization is handled by route
middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest.title: UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest

UpdatePasswordRequest.description:
Validates a self-service password change. The current password is verified in
the controller (against the stored hash); here we only enforce presence and
the new-password policy (min length + confirmation).
UpdatePasswordRequest.title: UpdatePasswordRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Validates a partial profile update for the authenticated user. Every field is
optional so the same endpoint serves admins (name/phone/avatar) and
freelancers (who additionally edit specialty/bio). Password changes go through
the dedicated UpdatePasswordRequest instead.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

UpdateResourceRequest.description:
Validates an edit to an existing workspace resource. Every field is optional
(`sometimes`) so the owner may patch a subset.
UpdateResourceRequest.title: UpdateResourceRequest

UpdateSiteContentRequest.description:
Validates a site-wide CMS payload. The body is `{ "content": <blob> }` where
the blob is a free-form, bilingual, partial-override array whose shape varies
per content key (site / faq / about / how_it_works). The nested structure is
intentionally unconstrained — the frontend supplies i18n defaults for
anything omitted, so partial saves must pass. Authorization is handled by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UpdateSiteContentRequest.title: UpdateSiteContentRequest

UpdateSubscriptionFinancialRequest.description:
Financial terms of a subscription. Every field is optional so the owner can
patch a subset; sending null clears the plan, custom price or hours.
Cross-field rules (plan vs hours vs seat) live in the service.
UpdateSubscriptionFinancialRequest.title: UpdateSubscriptionFinancialRequest

UpdateUserStatusRequest.description:
Validates an admin user-status transition. Authorization is enforced by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UpdateUserStatusRequest.title: UpdateUserStatusRequest

UpdateWorkspaceFeaturesRequest.description:
Validates a partial feature-flag update. Authorization is enforced by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin + can.permission).
UpdateWorkspaceFeaturesRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceFeaturesRequest

UpdateWorkspaceMessagingRequest.description:
Validates a workspace owner's own messaging payload
`{ use_platform?: bool, smtp?: {...}, sms?: {...} }`. Same secret-blank rules
as the platform request: omit or blank a secret to keep the stored value.
Ownership is enforced via the 'manage-workspace' gate in the controller.
UpdateWorkspaceMessagingRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceMessagingRequest

UploadAboutImageRequest.description:
Validates a single About-section image upload. Authorization is handled by
the route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UploadAboutImageRequest.title: UploadAboutImageRequest

UploadBrandingImageRequest.description:
Validates a single branding-asset upload (favicon or a light/dark logo).

Accepts the raster formats used elsewhere plus SVG (logos/favicons are often
vector). Authorization is handled by the route middleware (auth:sanctum +
role.admin).

image.description: SVG is not an image() per GD, so validate by extension/mime only.

UploadBrandingImageRequest.title: UploadBrandingImageRequest

UploadLandingImageRequest.description:
Validates a single landing-section image upload. Authorization is handled by
the route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UploadLandingImageRequest.title: UploadLandingImageRequest

UploadReceiptRequest.description:
Validates a payment-receipt upload (pdf/jpg/png, max 5MB). Uploading a receipt
is the admin's proof of payment, so the invoice is marked paid by the handler;
an optional `paid_at` backdates that payment. Authorization is enforced by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UploadReceiptRequest.title: UploadReceiptRequest

can_use_two_factor.description:
Only the local email/password account (the internal admin) may change
its password; SSO-provisioned users have their credentials at the IdP.

VoidExpenseRequest.description: A void always carries the reason it happened (it ends up in the activity log).
VoidExpenseRequest.title: VoidExpenseRequest

WorkspaceCurrency.description: The eight currencies a workspace may price in (SRS NFR-I18N).
WorkspaceCurrency.title: WorkspaceCurrency

logo.description:
The workspace's dedicated logo, falling back to the owner's avatar
when none is set (see Workspace::logoUrl, which stays N+1-free).

seats_summary.description: Detail-only bundle: present when the controller attaches it.

owner.description: Admin listing only: present when the owner relation is loaded.

features.description: Admin listing only: present when the flag rows are eager-loaded.

WorkspaceTimezone.description: The sixteen IANA time zones a workspace may operate in (SRS NFR-I18N).
WorkspaceTimezone.title: WorkspaceTimezone

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
